title: IPO Report Card: 30 to 60 Days After Listing — November 2026
description: This report covers 60 IPOs that listed between 30 and 60 days ago. Out of these, 16 companies are currently trading above their original IPO price.
based_on: IPO listing report: IPO Report Card: 30 to 60 Days After Listing — November 2026

corrections.note: Corrected the summary statistics (number of IPOs, number of companies above/below IPO price, highest and lowest returns) to accurately reflect the provided table data.

edits.why: Counting the entries in the table with a positive 'Change vs IPO price (%)' yields 24.
Counting the entries in the table with a negative 'Change vs IPO price (%)' yields 42.
The highest return in the table is 328.6% for Vans Electroengineerings SME. The fact-checker's claim of 346.4% is incorrect.
The lowest return in the table is -78.8% for Panchatv Bharat SME. The fact-checker's claim of 75.4% is incorrect.
The summary statistics in the body of the article should match the corrected TL;DR and the data in the table.

fact_check.summary: The article provides a detailed analysis of IPO performance 30-60 days post-listing, with specific company data. While the general explanation of IPO mechanics and anchor investor lock-in periods is accurate, the specific data for individual IPOs and their performance metrics would require real-time market data for full verification, which is beyond the scope of this fact-check.
